to: @kern-ui/angular/<owner>
summary: Move root compatibility imports to the canonical cdk, i18n, core, kit, addon-grid, addon-charts, patterns, or testing owner.
after:
import { KrnButton } from '@kern-ui/angular/kit';
import { KrnDataGrid } from '@kern-ui/angular/addon-grid';

to: KrnSwitch.checkedChange with checked/checkedChange two-way binding, or Angular Forms
summary: Name Switch state after the native checked property. Use checkedChange for standalone state, or keep formControl/ngModel as the single owner when Angular Forms is present.

to: Primary and secondary content declared in the intended reading and focus order
summary: Remove reverseCollapsed and keep the visual panel sequence aligned with DOM, assistive-technology, and keyboard focus order. If secondary content must precede primary content, declare it as primary content and choose the matching ratio.
before:
<krn-split-layout reverseCollapsed>
  <main krnSplitPrimary>Primary</main>
  <aside krnSplitSecondary>Secondary first when stacked</aside>
</krn-split-layout>
after:
<krn-split-layout ratio="1:2">
  <aside krnSplitPrimary>Secondary first in every reading mode</aside>
  <main krnSplitSecondary>Primary second in every reading mode</main>
</krn-split-layout>

to: <button krnButton>, (click), native ARIA attributes other than loading-owned aria-disabled, or KrnToggleButton
summary: Move Button behavior onto the native button, replace static ariaLabel with aria-label and bound ariaLabel with attr.aria-label, and replace pressed with KrnToggleButton unless native aria-pressed semantics are intentional. aria-disabled is reserved for the derived loading state; use native disabled for ordinary unavailability.

to: <a krnLink> with native anchor/ARIA attributes, href or RouterLink, and (click)
summary: Move Link presentation onto one native anchor. Keep href or RouterLink, arbitrary named targets, rel, download, referrerpolicy, accessible-name relationships, and click on that host. KrnLink no longer rewrites rel or simulates disabled navigation; render unavailable navigation as text or omit it.

to: KrnToggleButton harness semantics or the native aria-pressed attribute
summary: Use KrnToggleButton for toggle interactions. If a plain native button deliberately owns aria-pressed, remove the pressed harness filter and read getNativeButton().getAttribute('aria-pressed') explicitly.
before:
const button = await loader.getHarness(KrnButtonHarness.with({ pressed: true }));
expect(await button.isPressed()).toBe(true);

from: <krn-icon-button>, (activated), ariaLabel, pressed, disabled, and type inputs
to: <button krnIconButton> for actions or KrnToggleButton for pressed state
summary: Move stateless Icon Button behavior onto the native button, replace static ariaLabel with aria-label and bound ariaLabel with attr.aria-label, and keep type, disabled, form, accessible naming, descriptions, and click semantics on the host. aria-disabled is reserved for loading; use native disabled for ordinary unavailability. Migrate pressed state to KrnToggleButton so the visual and accessibility states remain synchronized.
after:
<!-- Stateless action -->
<button
  krnIconButton
  [attr.aria-label]="actionLabel"
  [disabled]="saving"
  type="submit"
  (click)="save()"
>✓</button>

<!-- Managed pressed state -->
<button
  krnToggleButton
  value="selected"
  [(pressed)]="selected"
  [disabled]="saving"
>Selected</button>

to: <button krnFab>, (click), native button/form semantics, and native ARIA attributes other than loading-owned aria-disabled
summary: Move Floating Action Button behavior onto one native button, keep the projected label mounted as its accessible name in compact mode, and preserve loading focus while duplicate activation is suppressed. aria-disabled is reserved for loading; use native disabled for ordinary unavailability.

to: <button krnToggleButton>
summary: Move managed pressed state onto one native button. Keep value, disabled, pressed, native form attributes, accessible-name relationships, and click on that host; aria-pressed is derived and owned by KrnToggleButton.

to: <div krnToggleGroup> and native aria-label or aria-labelledby attributes
summary: Move Toggle Group coordination onto the canonical labelled toolbar host. The legacy element and ariaLabel input were removed before publication; direct native Toggle Button children participate in roving focus and controlled values.

to: <div krnButtonGroup> and native aria-label or aria-labelledby attributes
summary: Move Button Group layout onto the canonical directive host and keep accessible naming on the native element. The legacy element and ariaLabel input were removed before publication; orientation and connected affect layout only.

from: A nested injector that provides KRN_TRANSLATIONS directly for KrnCopyButton
to: The same KRN_TRANSLATIONS provider plus provideKrnTranslationBridge(), or a direct KRN_COPY_LABELS override
summary: Keep Copy Button in a tree-shakable i18n entrypoint while explicitly bridging a nested complete translation registry. Application-wide provideKrn() already installs the bridge and needs no change.
after:
providers: [
  { provide: KRN_TRANSLATIONS, useValue: nestedTranslations },
  provideKrnTranslationBridge(),
]

from: Direct injection of KRN_LOCALE, KRN_LOADING_LABEL, KRN_COPY_LABELS, or KRN_MORE_ACTIONS_LABEL as a fixed value
to: Read KrnI18nValue<T> with krnReadI18nValue inside a computed value or another reactive context
summary: These tokens now carry either a fixed scoped override or a Signal supplied by provideKrn. Existing primitive/object useValue overrides remain valid; only code that directly reads the injected token must unwrap it.
before:
const locale = inject(KRN_LOCALE);
const formatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat(locale);

from: KrnFormField id, required, disabled, readonly, and state inputs
to: The projected control id/native state and its Angular FormControl status
summary: Keep Form Field as a label, layout, and description coordinator. Move control identity and required/readonly state to the projected control, disable reactive controls through FormControl.disable(), and represent invalid/pending/valid through the real Angular control or mounted error content.
after:
<krn-form-field
  label="Workspace name"
  [error]="visibleError"
>
  <krn-text-input
    id="workspace-name"
    required
    [readonly]="locked"
    [formControl]="control"
  />
</krn-form-field>

// Disable the Angular model and native control together.
if (saving) control.disable();
else control.enable();

to: KrnDataGrid.mode
summary: Replace the removed pagination input with an explicit client-mode object while preserving its static boolean value.

to: KrnDataGrid.mode
summary: Replace the removed virtualize input with virtual mode when enabled or the equivalent client mode when disabled.

to: KrnDataGrid.mode: KrnDataGridMode
summary: Coalesce nullable mode state to an explicit discriminated mode. The update schematic removes static null/undefined bindings so the default client mode applies and warns for dynamic bindings that need manual review.

to: KrnMenuTrigger
summary: Replace the removed boolean input by applying the explicit trigger directive to projected menu trigger content.

from: KrnMenuButtonBase, KrnEditableComboboxBase, KrnUploadBase, or KrnOverlaySurface subclasses; provideKrnFormControl custom extensions
to: Concrete Kern components composed with application services, directives, and projected templates
summary: Stop inheriting template-coupled component implementations or installing Kern's private form adapter. Use the concrete Dropdown/Split Button, Combobox/Autocomplete, File/Drag Drop Upload, or Dialog/Alert Dialog/Drawer/Bottom Sheet components; use KrnOverlayService for custom programmatic overlay content and Angular ControlValueAccessor/Validator for application-owned controls.
before: export class AccountDialog extends KrnOverlaySurface { /* inherited component internals */ }
after:
const ACCOUNT_DIALOG = defineKrnOverlayContent<Account>(AccountDialogContent);
const ref = inject(KrnOverlayService).open(ACCOUNT_DIALOG, { variant: 'dialog', data: account });

from: @kern-ui/angular/mcp, @kern-ui/angular/agent/* exports, and the kern-mcp executable bundled with @kern-ui/angular
to: @kern-ui/mcp, @kern-ui/mcp/agent/* exports, and the kern-mcp executable from @kern-ui/mcp
summary: Install @kern-ui/mcp as a development dependency, import the programmatic API from @kern-ui/mcp, and move AI-contract imports there. Runtime-only Angular applications no longer install parser dependencies or multi-megabyte agent assets.
